This is a confirmed, currently operating facility of Easylinehost Finland Oy, a small Finnish web hosting company, in Kuopio, Finland. The prior record for this facility carried no operator name; this registry corrects that gap directly based on the operator's own site.

Per its own site, Easylinehost has offered hosting services since 2004, including WordPress hosting, VPS, and domain registration, and describes its servers as centrally located within Finland. This is a small to mid-sized regional hosting provider rather than a large-scale enterprise data center or wholesale colocation operator, more comparable in scale to other small single-site hosting businesses tracked elsewhere in this registry (such as 1GServers in Phoenix or Thin-nology in Texas) than to major operators like Data4 or Elisa.

No specific IT capacity in megawatts, technical square footage, or year-opened date for this Kuopio facility was found in sourcing available this session, consistent with the more limited public disclosure typical of small regional hosting providers. Kuopio is a mid-sized city in eastern Finland; this facility likely represents a modest server room or small colocation suite rather than a purpose-built, large-scale data hall, though this registry has not independently confirmed the facility's physical scale beyond the company's own hosting-service description. Per its own site, Easylinehost describes itself as a 100 percent Finnish owned family business with about 15 employees and more than 1,000 customers, having offered hosting under the Easylinehost brand since 2004, with its current legal entity, Easylinehost Finland Oy, registered June 19, 2013. The company says its servers are physically located at its Kuopio headquarters inside converted former bank vaults, connected via three separate 10 gigabit links, running on solid state storage with redundant backups spread across multiple locations, cooled using outdoor air rather than mechanical air conditioning, and operated on a claimed carbon neutral basis.
